verses.1: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
verses.2: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.
verses.3: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
verses.4: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
